statements.impact_statement: The finding is in /usr/local/bin/gosu, a Go binary the upstream docker-library/postgres image ships and which this image inherits unchanged. gosu's entire job is to set uid/gid and exec the server: it opens no network connection, parses no mail, MIME or HTTP input, and runs once at container start before PostgreSQL is listening. The Go standard-library packages these advisories concern (net, net/http, net/mail, mime, os.Root) are therefore linked but never reached. Rebuilding gosu is upstream's to do; FerroEHR adds no Go code to this image.
